001package dev.nandi0813.api.Enum;
002
003/**
004 * The type of a match.
005 */
006public enum MatchType {
007
008    /** A 1v1 duel. */
009    DUEL,
010    /** A free-for-all between the members of one party. */
011    PARTY_FFA,
012    /** One party split into two teams. */
013    PARTY_SPLIT,
014    /** Two parties fighting each other. */
015    PARTY_VS_PARTY,
016    /** A practice match of one player against a bot opponent. Requires a bot addon. (2.8.0+) */
017    BOT,
018    /** A match type added by a newer core version. */
019    UNKNOWN
020
021}
